remarks: This impeccably maintained and upgraded townhouse at popular Winnipauk Village shows pride of ownership throughout. Step into the charming living room/dining area with wood burning corner fireplace, detailed moldings, rich laminate flooring and private entertainment sized deck surrounded by lovely mature landscaping. The updated eat-in kitchen features ample white cabinetry, granite counters, stainless appliances, easy care flooring and breezy ceiling fan. The convenient powder room completes the first floor. The second floor offers a sunny primary bedroom with wall of closets, spacious hall bath with sparkling neutral tile plus additional good sized bedroom also with great closet space. Pull down attic for additional storage plus full size stackable washer and dryer. Convenient reserved parking #141 plus plenty of visitor parking. You'll love the resort like amenities which add to a fantastic lifestyle- two luxurious pools, fitness center with racquetball and brand new pickle ball court offer recreation right out your doorstep. In addition, this convenient and coveted location is near all major shopping including fabulous SONO Collection, Route 7 and Metro North train stations, both the Merritt Parkway and 1-95. A Carefree Lifestyle Awaits!
